observations.evidence_surface: Polyphemus canonical project inbox acceptance regression plus project-session rule loading regressions

observations.result_summary: At the canonical assessed Polyphemus revision, a first-party native regression accepts a concrete proposed project AGENTS.md value through resolveInboxItem and verifies that the project-root AGENTS.md contains the accepted rule. At the same revision, session construction reads that project-root AGENTS.md and first-party runtime regressions verify concrete project rules are supplied to later model/agent execution contexts.
observations.notes: This record is function-neutral. The acceptance regression does not itself execute a subsequent model turn, and the runtime regressions use independently prepared concrete AGENTS.md fixtures rather than the accepted 'Real rules.' fixture. The record therefore establishes a tested concrete authoritative mutation plus an exact same-file native return path, not one synthetic end-to-end test, downstream behavioral compliance, or production deployment history.
